prompt.positive_points: list of [x, y] image pixel coordinates
prompt.negative_points: list of [x, y] image pixel coordinates
prompt.box: optional [x1, y1, x2, y2] ROI box
prompt.crop_to_box: optional boolean; run on local ROI and paste mask back

output.shape: same height and width as input or selected ROI
output.postprocess: select mask with highest score, then export 0/255 PNG

integration_note: Use the project's building/road segmentation model first. MobileSAM is used after user click/box input to add, delete, or replace a local mask region.
